name: eda
summary: Enables Event-Driven Ansible in the existing AAP custom resource.

lifecycle.idempotency: Leaves EDA enabled when it is already enabled and does not create event sources.
lifecycle.failure_boundary: Stops before patching when the AAP custom resource is absent.

readiness: The AAP custom resource reports EDA enabled.

security.secret_storage: No credential value is collected by this addon.
security.network_trust: Uses the local Kubernetes API trust configuration.
security.external_actions: No event source, rulebook activation, or external broker is created.
